title: Even When I Don't Understand
hook: Faithful God, there are things I don't understand today, but I choose to trust you.
prayer: You have carried me through harder seasons than this one. You held me when I didn't have the words to pray, and you opened doors I thought were shut for good.
So today I let go of my need to control everything. I give you the waiting, the answers that haven't come and the questions that keep me up at night.
Give me calm to wait for your timing and courage to move when you say go. Let my faith rest not on what I can see, but on who you are.
My future is safe in your hands.
tiktok_description: For when life doesn't make sense yet. 🕊️ Keep trusting.
